pids.019A: hybrid/EV vehicle system data, battery, voltage

source: obd-discover, on-car capture 2026-08-29; VIN pattern read from the vehicle
notes: Battery electric, and that is why its VIN was hard to read: a BEV has no engine ECU, so 7E0 does not exist on this car and every VIN attempt before discovery went to an address that is not there. Its live headers are 7DF and 7E2. The pattern here was read off the vehicle; vPIC confirms make, model, year and SE trim independently of the WMI mapping.
